row.evidence: Papaya Global's pricing page lists per-worker products (Contractor solution from $5 per contractor/month up to EOR from $499 per employee/month, Workforce OS by quote) and mentions no SSO, SAML or SCIM; its public API docs cover payments only.
row.notes: No public mention of SSO, SAML or SCIM on the pricing page, security page, FAQ, connectors list or the public Workforce Payments API docs. The help centre (support.papayaglobal.com) needs a customer login, so support articles could not be searched; status stays unknown rather than none. Pricing is per paid worker (employee or contractor), not per admin seat, so per-user fields are null. Papaya's connectors pull HRIS/ERP data (Workday, HiBob, BambooHR, SAP SuccessFactors and others); none are identity providers. Okta OIN, Entra gallery and JumpCloud catalogue URLs for Papaya Global returned 404/403. www.papayaglobal.com returned CloudFront 403 to a short user agent and to WebFetch and render.cjs, but loaded with a full desktop browser user agent.

plans.name: Workforce OS
plans.notes: Lists Custom Roles & Permissions and Enterprise-Grade Security Standards; no SSO/SCIM detail.

limitations.text: API keys are provided by Papaya integration support; tokens last 24 hours.
Beneficiary invite is for payees of the payments product, not console users.

user_api.notes: The public API (docs.papayaglobal.com) is a Workforce Payments API: wallets, payment groups, beneficiaries (payees, including POST /payments/beneficiaries/invite to invite a payee by email) and payments. It has no endpoints for platform admin users, roles or licences. Auth is an API key + client secret exchanged for a 24-hour bearer token, issued by integration support.

okta.notes: Not found: catalogue URL returned 404/403, and Papaya publishes no IdP setup guide.

entra.notes: Not found: catalogue URL returned 404/403, and Papaya publishes no IdP setup guide.

jumpcloud.notes: Not found: catalogue URL returned 404/403, and Papaya publishes no IdP setup guide.

fallbacks.notes: Public docs are the payments API only; help-centre articles need a customer login. Papaya HCM/ERP connectors feed worker data into Papaya and are not console-user provisioning.
